stages.title: LLM Fundamentals
stages.summary: Build a working mental model of what LLMs are, how they produce text, and where they fail.
goals: Explain tokens and why they matter for cost and limits
Understand context windows and what happens when you exceed them
Know how temperature and sampling affect output
Recognise hallucinations and other common failure modes

stages.title: Prompt Engineering
stages.summary: Learn to write clear instructions that get reliable, well-structured answers.
goals: Write clear, specific instructions with roles and context
Use few-shot examples to steer format and style
Apply step-by-step (chain-of-thought) prompting for reasoning tasks
Get structured output such as JSON that code can parse

stages.title: Using LLM APIs
stages.summary: Call models from code: SDKs, streaming, cost and rate limits, and running models locally.
goals: Make your first API call with the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini SDKs
Stream responses for a responsive UI
Estimate cost and handle rate limits with retries and backoff
Run open models locally with Ollama
